description: Create many users in Zendesk in a single request. Accepts up to 100 user objects. The operation is handled asynchronously — a background job is queued and you receive a job_status payload with an initial status of 'queued' or 'working'. Poll the job_status URL or use zendesk.get_job_statuses2 to check for completion and view per-user results. Use when onboarding multiple users at once or seeding test data. Note: This action is idempotent — re-running with the same external_ids may update existing users depending on Zendesk configuration.
